question: Which fierce goddess is invoked for constant personal protection?
premises: The distorted-faced goddess is asked to protect always.
She is identified as beloved of the great crooked one.
The speaker claims her as his own protector.
inference: Constant protection is sought from the distorted-faced goddess beloved of the great crooked one.
plain_english: May the distorted-faced goddess, beloved of the great crooked one, always protect me.
